verdict.rationale: AvaTax documents a public REST v2 API with per-method reference pages such as CreateTransaction and CreateNexus, an interactive API Explorer covering endpoints, parameters and authentication, and official SDKs in six languages. A 90-day free trial gives access to the APIs, so an AI-native user can drive the product programmatically. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec at the standard probed paths (all returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Avalara provides SDKs for the REST v2 APIs in the following languages: C#, Java, JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby
